title: 第21章 放在这里第22章 用带回来的材料建一所房子
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
只有获得了天道的认可，才能领悟到世界法则的核心，这是晋升圣人的必要条件之一。
然而，在原来的洪荒大陆，后土却未曾有过这样的机遇……
可是，如今摆在后土眼前的，却是一个难得的大好机会。
即便是她这种心性坚定的人，此时也难以抑制内心的激动。
“当然没意见，你远道而来，随便用吧！”
童元安自然不会有啥异议。
他甚至巴不得后土能早日发现一些自己不了解的秘密，为他解开种种疑惑。
“那你带回来的那些东西，放哪儿了？”
后土忽然想起这件事。
……
“啊，放哪儿来着？”
童元安顿时面露苦色，刚才光顾着研究天地的本质了，把这件头疼的事给忘了。
一时之间，他还真想不到有什么合适的地方。
空旷的地方虽然多得是，但这批妖兽肉和木材不是一般的材料，数量又特别多，还不方便让太多人看见，恐怕整个飞花市都找不到一个好地方。
“先找个大仓库，暂时存起来，回头再想办法。”
童元安这么决定着，只能先临时存放，再考虑怎么逐步处理。
对于如何处置这批特殊的肉类和木材，他还真没想明白，也确实得好好琢磨琢磨。
要知道，这些都是从遥远的神话时代带来的好东西，不论是口感还是品质，都比现实世界里的高太多。
如果不明不白地卖出去，怕是很快就会被有关部门盯上。
理由很简单：非法猎杀珍稀动物、擅自砍伐保护树木。

那些官员可不会管这些到底是不是什么奇异物种，反正只要是珍贵的东西就都在保护范围内。
就算他说自己是清白的，拿不出完整的证据也没用。
更何况洪荒时代的生物若是出现在这，可能引发的混乱他也控制不住。
“这事不难办，我直接把这些东西留在这里，你需要的时候随时来取就行。”
后土看出了他的为难之处，轻松一笑便提出了解决方案。
“放在这里？”
童元安有点儿懵，这是在地球的核心地带呀。
这儿的确很宽敞，还有种原始的力量环绕四周，不管放啥都不会变质。
然而对于后土来说出入自如，但他的修为连最低阶的小仙都不如，想要再进入这儿怕是找不到门路。
“你该不会是在逗我吧？就我现在的能力，怎么可能轻易进来。”
童元安无奈地摇头，实力这种事情真是无形之中打了人脸。
“放心，我已经有办法了。”
说罢只见后土双臂轻抬，掐动手诀，竟是直接操作大地法则！
“嗡——”
一股强烈的波动骤然出现。
这片区域开始剧烈震动，各种神秘符号随之浮现。
看上去，这些规律像是极力抵制后土的行为，一时间陷入了胶着状态。
“哼！”
后土冷声低哼，目光中闪过一抹寒芒，轻轻松松就把局面掌控住了。
“化！”

随着她低声念咒，一块古朴牌子凭空形成。
“拿着这个，只要你往里注入一点儿灵力，就可以随时开启这条通道进来了。”
她随手将牌子交给童元安，看似简单的举动却让他惊掉了下巴。
content_en:
Only by gaining the approval of Heaven can one understand the core of the laws of the world, which is one of the necessary conditions for promotion to a saint.
However, in the original prehistoric continent, Houtu had never had such an opportunity...
However, what is now in front of Hou Tu is a rare and great opportunity.
Even a determined person like her could not suppress her inner excitement at this time.
"Of course I have no objection. You have come all the way, so you can use it as you wish!"
童元安自然不会有啥异议。
He even wished that Hou Tu could discover some secrets that he didn't understand as soon as possible and solve all kinds of doubts for him.
"Then where did you put those things you brought back?"
后土忽然想起这件事。
…
“啊，放哪儿来着？”
Tong Yuan'an suddenly had a bitter look on his face. He had just been busy studying the nature of heaven and earth and had forgotten this troublesome matter.
For a moment, he really couldn't think of any suitable place.
Although there are many open places, this batch of monster meat and wood are not ordinary materials, and the quantity is extremely large. It is not convenient for too many people to see it. I am afraid that there will not be a good place in Feihua City.
"First find a big warehouse, store it temporarily, and then think of a solution later."
Tong Yuanan decided that he could only temporarily store it first, and then consider how to deal with it gradually.
He really hasn't figured out how to deal with this special batch of meat and wood, and he really needs to think about it carefully.
You must know that these are good things brought from the distant mythical era. Both the taste and quality are much higher than those in the real world.
If you sell it without knowing it, you may be targeted by the relevant departments soon.
The reason is simple: illegal hunting of rare animals and unauthorized felling of protected trees.
Those officials don't care whether these are exotic species. Anyway, as long as they are precious things, they are within the scope of protection.
Even if he claims that he is innocent, it is useless if he cannot provide complete evidence.
What's more, if a creature from the prehistoric era appeared here, he couldn't control the chaos it might cause.
"It's not difficult to do. I'll just leave these things here. You can just come and pick them up whenever you need them."
Hou Tu saw his dilemma and offered a solution with a relaxed smile.
"Put it here?"
Tong Yuanan was a little confused. This was the core area of the earth.
It's really spacious here, and there's a primitive power surrounding it, so no matter what you put it in, it won't deteriorate.
However, Hou Tu can come and go freely, but his cultivation level is not as good as that of the lowest level immortal. If he wants to enter here again, he may not be able to find a way.
"Are you kidding me? With my current ability, how can I come in easily?"
Tong Yuanan shook his head helplessly. Strength was a slap in the face.
“放心，我已经有办法了。”
After saying that, Hou Tu raised his arms slightly and made a hand gesture, which was actually a direct manipulation of the laws of the earth!
"Buzz——"
一股强烈的波动骤然出现。
The area began to shake violently, and various mysterious symbols appeared.
It seems that these rules are like trying to resist Hou Tu's behavior and fell into a stalemate for a while.
"Hmph!"
Hou Tu hummed in a cold voice, a cold light flashed in his eyes, and he took control of the situation easily.
"Chemistry!"
As she muttered the incantation, a simple sign formed out of thin air.
"Take this, as long as you inject a little spiritual power into it, you can open this channel and come in at any time."
She casually handed the sign to Tong Yuanan, but this seemingly simple move made his jaw drop.
